== Strategy==

===Commander===
Sideswipe is a pretty basic Scout, but his main advantages are buffed Critical Attacks, flat Power charging and buff nullify on Special III.

As of August 1, 2019, Sideswipe gained a rework that made him even more of a damage-dealer. Even though there are better Scouts out there, increased Crit damage and Shock purification adds a punch to his attacks.

===Opponent ===
==== General ====
As you're more likely to hit an opponent Sideswipe more than he hits your Bot, he will Evade often. Any one-hit or two-hit Special Attacks should be activated when Sideswipe does not have Agility active. 

If using Ranged Heavy Attack Bots like [[Bludgeon]], don't spam ranged heavies; it will give Sideswipe more Power as he sidesteps them.

==== Rulers of Kaon ====
Anti-evasion is your key to win. The buff that grants him power from evasion is pretty powerful, and that in addition to the gain from his natural ranged sidestep, can generate a lot of power. It might potentially propel him to a quick Special 3.

===Strong Match-ups===
*'''[[Rhinox]]''' - Sideswipe can remove all of Rhinox's Shields in a single combo. But be careful not to get Power Locked while Sideswipe is charging Power. And getting Shocked by his shields won't be so annoying anymore if Sideswipe is quick to Purify them.
*'''[[Mixmaster]] - '''Sideswipe's Special 3 can nullify Mixmaster's buffs.
*'''[[Megatron (ROTF)]] -''' Burns and strong critical hits will bypass Megatron’s tough armor and the red speedster will ensure that Megatron does not repair at the end of the fight with his special 3.
*'''[[Grimlock]]''' - What’s a King without melee buffs?
*'''[[Shockwave]]''' - Heavy Attacks will purify Shockwave's annoying Shocks and prevent him from draining too much power.                                              

=== Mods ===

* Unstable Energon - Sideswipe's Heavy Attack doesn't need a successful hit to purify a shock.

===Weak Match-ups===
*'''[[Bonecrusher]]''' - Sideswipe will be punished by Bleeding as he inflicts Critical Attacks.
*[[Hot Rod|'''Hot Rod''']]''' - '''Decelerating the red speedster lowers his power gain rate and stops evasion.
*'''[[Kickback]]''' - Heavy attacks at the beginning of the match can eat up Sideswipe's power gains.
*'''[[Grindor]]''' - Sideswipe gains a lot of power because of his power gain and the more power Sideswipe gains, the stronger Grindor gets and special locks and power locks will disable Sideswipe from using his specials. Grindor will smash the red speedster before he will know it.
*'''[[Megatronus]]''' - the relic of obedience will prevent this red speedster from evading and gaining more power.

===Recommended Modules===
*The [[Nightbird's Mark|'''Nightbird's Mark''']]<nowiki/>will enhance Sideswipe's Critical Hits and Evade.
*[[Tech Console|'''Tech Console''']] - Only when Sideswipe's Signature Ability is awakened is this Module useful.
*[[Scout's Sentry|'''Scout's Sentry''']]''' - ''' Sideswipewill gain more Power from an increased Critical Rate and Power Lock the opponent when he evades.
*[[Prime Module|'''Prime Module''']] - Increases Sideswipe's base stats.
*'''[[E.M.I. Module]]''' - Sideswipe gains Power when he sidesteps ranged attacks and this bot will make opponents to have a harder time to make a touch.

==Updates==
Sideswipe has received several major updates to rebalance his damage output.
*2018, 5.1 update: <ref>https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/3739/upcoming-bot-changes-january-31st-updated</ref>
** Sideswiped lacked damage output so was given bursts of damage and increased the chances for him to land important hits.
**Increased Power Gain when Sidestepping Ranged Attacks by 20%.
**Increased Stun duration by .5 seconds. i.e. Special 1 Stun from 1.5 to 2.5 seconds.
**Evasion strength increased by 20%, from 20~23~27~32~38%, to 30~38%. And Special 2 Evade duration increased from 6 to 8 seconds.
**Special Attack 2’s Missile now inflicts Burn, dealing 60% of his Attack over 6 seconds.
**Special Attack 3’s Missile now inflicts Burn, dealing 80% of his Attack over 6 seconds.
*April 2019, 8.0 update: <ref>https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/comment/75733#Comment_75733</ref> 
**Added +3.6% to base Critical Rate.
**Added +10% to base Critical Damage.
**Special 2 chance to Burn increased to 100%.
*August 2019, 8.1 update: <ref>https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/8720/sideswipe-balance-update</ref>
**When Sideswipe is knocked down, he will only lose 5 Critical Chance Buffs, instead of all of them.
**When Sideswipe has 10 Critical Hit Chance Buffs, and successfully lands a Special 2 Attack, he will gain a 50% Critical Damage buff for a set duration of 10 seconds.
**When Sideswipe hits with a Heavy Attack, he will refresh all of his Critical Damage Buffs.
**When Sideswipe hits with a Heavy Attack, he will purify all Shock Debuffs.
**Sideswipe's Signature Ability has been adjusted to grant a maximum of 50% of his Maximum Power.  This change fixed a bug where his potency was reduced and did not match, thus making his Signature Ability work better than before, even though the maximum potential has been reduced.
*Clarified or tweaked so that his Heavy Attack effects do not have to hit to activate.

**When Sideswipe hits with a Heavy Attack, he will purify all Shock Debuffs.
**Sideswipe's Signature Ability has been adjusted to grant a maximum of 50% of his Maximum Power.  This change fixed a bug where his potency was reduced and did not match, thus making his Signature Ability work better than before, even though the maximum potential has been reduced.
*Clarified or tweaked so that his Heavy Attack effects do not have to hit to activate.
